paper.title: Interference Constrained Beam Alignment for Time-Varying Channels via Kernelized Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Constrained non-stationary Gaussian process (kernelized) bandit, variation budget unknown
unmapped: Unknown time-varying constraint function g_t in an RKHS observed with noise; long-term (cumulative) constraint violation V(T) is also bounded
RKHS norm bounds ||f_t|| <= B, ||g_t|| <= G known to the algorithm; kernels bounded by 1
Slater condition with constant tau > 0; tau used to set rho = 4B/tau
Variation budgets in RKHS norm: sum ||f_{t+1}-f_t|| <= B_f, sum ||g_{t+1}-g_t|| <= B_g (not known to the learner)
Comparator is the best (randomized) feasible policy at each round
settings.definition_quote: We assume that the variations in  reward and constraint functions are bounded, i.e. $\sum_{t=1}^{T-1} \|f_{t+1}-f_t\|_{\mathbb H_k} \leq B_f$ and $\sum_{t=1}^{T-1} \|g_{t+1}-g_t\|_{\mathbb H_{\tilde k}} \leq B_g$.

symbols.rho: upper bound of the dual variable projection, rho >= 4B/tau
symbols.G: RKHS norm bound of the constraint function
symbols.gamma_hat: max of the maximum information gains of the reward and constraint kernels at T
symbols.B_Delta: max(B_f, B_g), combined RKHS-norm variation budget

source.label: thm: bound
source.quote: If the restart period $W= \hat \gamma_T^{\frac{1}{4}} T^{\frac{1}{2}}$, for any $\rho \geq \frac{4B}{\tau}$, the regret $R(T)$ and constraint violation  $V(T)$  in Algorithm~ \ref{alg} at time $T$ are bounded by: R(T) \leq  O \left(\rho G  \sqrt{T} + \rho \hat \gamma_T^{\frac{7}{8}} B_{\Delta} T^{\frac{3}{4}}\right).

results.notes: Probability type not stated explicitly; the analysis relies on GP-UCB concentration with confidence parameter delta, so recorded as high-probability. Regret is against the per-round best feasible randomized policy. Same bound restated in Lemma 7.
